description: Work out a numerology Life Path number from a birth date, keeping the master numbers 11, 22 and 33, with each step of the sum, the number's name and its approved plain meaning, and a link to the free Life Path page. Use when someone asks "what's my life path number", "my numerology number" or "am I a master number". Doing the sum this way avoids the common slip of adding all digits at once, which loses master numbers. Only the birth date is needed.
name: get_life_path_number
title: Life Path number
